title: Sweroside ameliorates IMQ-induced psoriasiform inflammation by inhibiting NLRP3/Caspase-1 mediated IL-1beta elevation.
authors: Su, Haojie; Yue, Hongyu; Liu, Fanlu; Sun, Yue; Liang, Shulin; Zheng, Xuwei; Zhang, YaTing; Zhang, Junhong; Wu, Jingjing; Han, Ling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Sweroside对银屑病炎症的抑制作用，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune skin disorder with no cure, posing challenges in long-term therapy and economic burden. Sweroside (SOS), an iridoid compound from Gentiana, shows promise for treatment due to its anti-inflammatory properties. In this study, SOS significantly reduced erythema, thickening, and scaling in IMQ-induced psoriasiform mice, lowered serum TNF-alpha and IL-1beta levels, and suppressed inflammatory marker expression. Molecular docking revealed strong binding to IL-1beta and NLRP3 proteins. Western blot and RT-PCR confirmed that SOS inhibited NLRP3, Cleaved-Caspase-1, ASC, and IL-1beta expression. SOS's inhibition of IL-1beta production is mediated through the NLRP3/Caspase-1 pathway. Additionally, SOS regulates IL-1beta signal transduction and precursor production, exhibiting anti-inflammatory effects linked to NF-kappaB signaling inhibition in HaCaT cells. Thus, SOS has potential as a psoriasis treatment.
abstract_zh: 银屑病是一种慢性自身免疫性皮肤病，目前尚无治愈方法，给长期治疗带来挑战并造成经济负担。獐牙菜苷（SOS），一种来自龙胆属的环烯醚萜类化合物，因其抗炎特性显示出治疗潜力。在本研究中，SOS显著减轻了IMQ诱导的银屑病样小鼠的红斑、增厚和鳞屑，降低了血清TNF-α和IL-1β水平，并抑制了炎症标志物的表达。分子对接显示其与IL-1β和NLRP3蛋白有强结合。Western blot和RT-PCR证实，SOS抑制了NLRP3、Cleaved-Caspase-1、ASC和IL-1β的表达。SOS对IL-1β产生的抑制作用是通过NLRP3/Caspase-1通路介导的。此外，SOS调节IL-1β信号转导及其前体产生，在HaCaT细胞中表现出与NF-κB信号抑制相关的抗炎效应。因此，SOS具有作为银屑病治疗药物的潜力。
